column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “poor” is rendered “afflicted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I am faithful” is rendered “I am a godly man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the lowest Sheol” is rendered “the depths of Sheol.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ruthless ones” is rendered “violent men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “long of anger” is rendered “Slow to anger,” and “faithfulness” as “truth.”
